inputs.note: parse_reported_flag over unreadable glyphs and over printed N / WNL / HH / ll.

expected: An unreadable glyph is `unrecognised` — the report asserted something we cannot read — and stays distinguishable from a blank column, which asserted nothing. N and WNL remain printed assertions of normality.
guards_against: Collapsing 'unreadable' into 'not printed', which loses the cause of a not_reported outcome in exactly the log line that would explain it.
